title: CI job checks-merge-install finishes inside its 30-minute cap, so main's push run is not cancelled
why: checks-merge-install hit its 30-minute cap and main's push run 43164094808 on f024eae4e was cancelled, so the merge tool reads main as UNKNOWN and every merge waits.
note: Stability fix. Lane started 01:01 CST Nov 12. Batch runner 10 re-runs the main run once meanwhile. Related: step ci-job-caps-line-count.
